dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Dear all sailors, passengers, residents, traveling merchants, tourists, and everyone else in Liyue: If you require any assistance for dispute mediation, public affairs, document processing, or other matters, please visit the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: No matter if your issue at hand is big or small, the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs will serve you wholeheartedly.
